title: Contract 4 — PROGRESS (P2 to P5)
description: Response body of GET /turns/{turn_id}/status. Catalyst does not support long-lived streaming connections, so P5 polls this every 400ms. The stage sequence is also the explainability trace, so it is materialised in Cache rather than merely logged.

stage.description: Current stage. Terminal states are DONE and FAILED; on either, P5 stops polling and calls GET /turns/{turn_id}.

note.description: Optional one-liner, e.g. 'scope narrowed to own unit' or 'page 2 of 3'.

poll_after_ms.description: Server-suggested next poll delay. Lets the backend back off under load without a frontend change.

terminal.description: True when stage is DONE or FAILED. Present so P5 never has to hardcode the enum.
